articles.title: JWST finds early galaxies may be 4 times more massive than thought
articles.originalTitle: JWST finds early galaxies may be 4 times more massive than thought
articles.excerpt: Astronomers using JWST have discovered that massive early galaxies contain far more small, faint stars than expected. It could also suggest that planets around low-mass stars were more common in the early universe than scientists realized.
